note.en: Deschamps keeps France ruthlessly practical: defend the center, manage momentum, and let elite transition players decide matches.
note.zh: 德尚让法国保持极其务实：守住中路、管理比赛势头，并让顶级转换球员决定比赛。

history.en: Appointed in 2012, he led France to the 2018 World Cup title, the Euro 2016 final, and the 2022 World Cup final.
history.zh: 他于2012年上任，带领法国赢得2018年世界杯，打进2016年欧洲杯决赛和2022年世界杯决赛。

note.en: De la Fuente keeps Spain connected to its possession identity while adding vertical runners and trust in players he developed through the youth teams.
note.zh: 德拉富恩特让西班牙延续控球身份，同时加入纵向跑动者，并信任自己在青年队培养过的球员。

history.en: Promoted to the senior job in 2022, he previously led Spain's under-19, under-21, and Olympic teams.
history.zh: 他于2022年升任成年队主帅，此前执教过西班牙19岁以下、21岁以下和奥运代表队。

note.en: Tuchel is detail-heavy: he likes control, clear roles, counter-pressing, and patient problem-solving against packed defenses.
note.zh: 图赫尔非常重视细节：他喜欢控制、清晰角色、丢球反抢，以及面对密集防守时耐心解决问题。

history.en: Appointed England head coach in 2025, he brought Champions League-winning club experience from Chelsea plus major roles at Dortmund, PSG, and Bayern Munich.
history.zh: 他于2025年出任英格兰主教练，带来在切尔西赢得欧冠的俱乐部经验，以及执教多特蒙德、巴黎圣日耳曼和拜仁慕尼黑的履历。

history.en: Appointed in 2018, he lifted the 2021 Copa America, 2022 Finalissima, 2022 World Cup, and 2024 Copa America.
